title: Director, Enterprise Sales
location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
description:
Why join us
 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
 Sales at Brex
 The Sales team is the driving force behind revenue at Brex, and Enterprise Sales continues to scale Brex upmarket. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring customers, and expanding value across our portfolio. Brex wins by changing how companies control spend (corporate cards, spend management, and expense in one platform, with AI agents that act upstream of the expense report) against both legacy tools and modern competitors. We celebrate individual accomplishments and team wins, with a high-performance culture rooted in collaboration, transparency, and execution.
 What You’ll Do
 As Director of Sales for our Enterprise segment, you will lead a team of approximately five Account Executives driving new customer acquisition as Brex moves further upmarket. You will own team performance and help customers build the business case for an enterprise-wide platform spanning corporate cards, spend management, and e…

title: Product Engineer II – ArcGIS Arcade
description:
Overview

Bring your enthusiasm and knowledge of GIS customization to help build and test advancements to ArcGIS Arcade. Arcade is used by organisations around the world to customize their workflows, QA/QC data input, and create cutting edge visualisations. This is a fantastic opportunity to become part of the product development team and support the delivery of regular, high-quality releases in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Help us improve our Arcade functional capabilities, test routines, and documentation as part of the ArcGIS Pro development team developing Arcade. You’ll also collaborate with engineers on other products to ensure seamless integration across ArcGIS.

Esri has a Relocation Assistance Program and can provide support with relocating to the Cardiff, UK area for this position. Check out more details of the Esri R&D Center – Cardiff!

Responsibilities

  • Apply curious, independent thought, and attention to detail to explore and understand the challenges that ArcGIS users face and provide usable, informative feedback on user experience
  • Build rich and varied GIS datasets and maps, sample applications and articles that can be used to highlight product capabilities, explain scripting functions, and guide scripting best practices
  • Work with your development team, and teams across Esri, to design, create, and validate the newest datasets and GIS workflows to support visualisation, map labelling, pop-ups, attribute rules and verify the functionality meets user workflows and is consistent with Esri ecosystem
  • Describe GIS best practices and demonstrate how to apply these GIS workflows in internal team meetings, on product forums and websites, with customers, at Esri events, or in publications like the ArcGIS Blog
